cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Raise the Impossibility
cards.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your invisible friend can bring her family to my wedding. Tell them I've set places beside me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They walk through walls when they're bored. Are you sure?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They can wander. I'll book a ballroom that follows them; my guests aren't missing cake because a wall got in the way.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The ballroom can split when they go different ways. Do you want that option?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take it, and order a cake that multiplies with the rooms. Everyone beside me gets the first slice; we'll need enough versions of me to cut them.

reason: Turn B questions into A permissive host decisions, then raise the splitting-room offer through cakes and multiplying host justified by the already promised place beside A.
